newsitem.title: FRANCE: CanalPlus denies satellite clients cancel.
newsitem.headline: CanalPlus denies satellite clients cancel.

text.p: Bruno Delcour, chairman of Canalsatellite, Canal Plus's satellite unit, denied market talk on Friday that subscribers to Canalsatellite were cancelling their subscriptions to Canal Plus's main pay television service.
"It seems that between 70 and 71 percent of Canal Plus subscribers have added Canalsatellite on to their subscription; there is no competition effect," he told Reuters.

Analysts said Canal Plus shares were hit by worries after an analysts' meeting that subscribers to Canal Plus's main pay TV service were cancelling their subscriptions in favour of signing up to Canalsatellite.

Canal Plus shares were 23 francs or 2.06 percent lower at 1,091 francs at 1115 GMT in thin volume of 39,311 shares. The share fell as low as 1,073 earlier in the day. The CAC-40 index was down 1.22 percent.

Canalsatellite had 476,000 subscribers at the end of February, of whom 253,000 subscribed to its digital service, compared with 446,000 subscribers of whom 204,000 were digital subscribers, at the end of 1996.
The digital service was launched in December.
